cohort: The study included all pregnant women with HIV who delivered at C U Shah Medical College and Hospital, Surendranagar, Gujarat, between January 2018 and December 2022.
finding: Among HIV-positive pregnant women, 65% experienced maternal complications, and 1.8% of babies tested positive for HIV at 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: 60% of HIV-positive patients underwent vaginal delivery, and 40% underwent lower segment cesarean section.
